Playwright Test runs tests from a single file in the order of declaration, unless you parallelize tests in a single file.

q: How to Sort test files alphabetically
answer: Though not followed much ----- When you disable parallel test execution (ex: --workers =1), Playwright Test runs test files in alphabetical order. You can use some naming convention to control the test order, for example `001-user-signin-flow.spec.ts`, `002-create-new-document.spec.ts` and so on.
